```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

plot_metabolite_4quadrant_pdf <- function(
    repo_local_dir = NULL,
    pdf_output_path,
    selected_tissue = "blood",
    gsutil_cmd = "gsutil"
) {
  # --- 1. Load required libraries ---
  required_libs <- c(
    "dplyr", "ggplot2", "tidyverse", "glue",
    "MotrpacHumanPreSuspension", "MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData",
    "openxlsx", "PMA", "ggrepel","ggforce"
  )
  missing_libs <- required_libs[!sapply(required_libs, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)]
  if (length(missing_libs) > 0) {
    stop(paste0("Missing packages: ", paste(missing_libs, collapse = ", "),
                ". Please install them first."))
  }
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(lapply(required_libs, library, character.only = TRUE))
  
  plot_dir  <- dirname(pdf_output_path)
  
  if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
    dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Plot output directory: {plot_dir}"))
  }
  
  # --- 2. Set colors ---
  color_exercise <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspension::HUMAN_EXERCISE_GROUP_COLORS
  color_resist <- color_exercise[["ADUResist"]]
  color_endur <- color_exercise[["ADUEndur"]]
  color_control <- color_exercise[["ADUControl"]]
  
  # --- 3. Load DA data ---
  differential_analysis <- load_differential_analysis(
    repo_local_dir = repo_local_dir,
    selected_omes = "all",
    selected_tissues = selected_tissue,
    single_matrix = TRUE,
    combine_with_featgene = TRUE,
    epigen = FALSE,
    gsutil = gsutil_cmd
  ) %>%
    filter(contrast_type == "exercise_with_controls") %>%
    mutate(
      assay = if_else(str_detect(assay, "metab"), "metab", assay),
      gene_symbol = if_else(assay == "metab", feature_id, gene_symbol)
    )
  
  # --- 4. Filter for blood metabolites ---
  differential_analysis_metab_targeted <- differential_analysis %>%
    filter(tissue == "blood", assay == "metab") %>%
    distinct(feature_id, p_value, randomGroupCode, Timepoint, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # --- 5. Post-10 min Endurance and Resistance datasets ---
  targeted_df_post_10_min_ADUEndur <- differential_analysis_metab_targeted %>%
    filter(Timepoint == "post_10_min", randomGroupCode == "ADUEndur") %>%
    mutate(
      sig = ifelse(adj_p_value < 0.05, "FDR Significant",
                   ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "Nominal Significant", "Not Significant")),
      sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUEndur = ifelse(adj_p_value < 0.05, 1, 0),
      post_10_min_ADUEndur_logFC = logFC
    )
  
  targeted_df_post_10_min_ADUResist <- differential_analysis_metab_targeted %>%
    filter(Timepoint == "post_10_min", randomGroupCode == "ADUResist") %>%
    mutate(
      sig = ifelse(adj_p_value < 0.05, "FDR Significant",
                   ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "Nominal Significant", "Not Significant")),
      sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUResist = ifelse(adj_p_value < 0.05, 1, 0),
      post_10_min_ADUResist_logFC = logFC
    )
  
  # --- 6. Combine and annotate significance category ---
  post_10_min_4quadrant <- left_join(
    targeted_df_post_10_min_ADUEndur %>%
      dplyr::select(feature_id, post_10_min_ADUEndur_logFC, sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUEndur),
    targeted_df_post_10_min_ADUResist %>%
      dplyr::select(feature_id, post_10_min_ADUResist_logFC, sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUResist),
    by = "feature_id"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      sig = case_when(
        sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUEndur == 1 & sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUResist == 1 ~
          "FDR significant: EE & RE",
        sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUEndur == 1 & sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUResist == 0 ~
          "FDR significant: EE",
        sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUEndur == 0 & sig_diff_post_10_min_ADUResist == 1 ~
          "FDR significant: RE",
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      )
    )
  
  post_10_min_4quadrant <- post_10_min_4quadrant %>%
    mutate(sig = factor(sig, levels = c(
      "FDR significant: EE & RE",
      "FDR significant: EE",
      "FDR significant: RE",
      "Not significant"
    )))
  
  
  # --- 7. Build scatterplot ---
  p <- ggplot(post_10_min_4quadrant,
              aes(x = post_10_min_ADUEndur_logFC,
                  y = post_10_min_ADUResist_logFC)) +
    
    # Draw Not Significant FIRST (background)
    geom_point(data = post_10_min_4quadrant %>% filter(sig == "Not significant"),
               aes(color = sig),
               size = 2, alpha = 0.4) +
    
    # FDR significant EE & RE
    geom_point(data = post_10_min_4quadrant %>% filter(sig == "FDR significant: EE & RE"),
               aes(color = sig), size = 3) +
    
    # FDR significant EE
    geom_point(data = post_10_min_4quadrant %>% filter(sig == "FDR significant: EE"),
               aes(color = sig), size = 3) +
    
    # FDR significant RE
    geom_point(data = post_10_min_4quadrant %>% filter(sig == "FDR significant: RE"),
               aes(color = sig), size = 3) +
    
    # Text labels only for FDR-significant
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = post_10_min_4quadrant %>% filter(sig != "Not significant"),
      aes(label = feature_id),
      size = 6, color = "black", max.overlaps = 12
    ) +
    
    # Color legend (no title)
    scale_color_manual(
      name = NULL,
      values = c(
        "FDR significant: EE & RE" = color_control,
        "FDR significant: EE" = color_endur,
        "FDR significant: RE" = color_resist,
        "Not significant" = "darkgray"
      ),
      breaks = c(
        "FDR significant: EE & RE",
        "FDR significant: EE",
        "FDR significant: RE",
        "Not significant"   # ← LAST
      )
    ) +
    
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    labs(x = "EE logFC", y = "RE logFC") +
    xlim(-2, 2) + ylim(-2, 2) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",     # <-- legend at bottom
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),  # nicer legend labels
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Restrict to strongest Q4 points (keeps ellipse tighter & horizontal)
  quad4_tight <- post_10_min_4quadrant %>%
    filter(
      post_10_min_ADUEndur_logFC > 0.15,   # small threshold → adjust if needed
      post_10_min_ADUResist_logFC < -0.2
    )
  
  p <- p +
    stat_ellipse(
      data = quad4_tight,
      aes(
        x = post_10_min_ADUEndur_logFC,
        y = post_10_min_ADUResist_logFC
      ),
      type = "norm",       # fit ellipse to data
      level = 0.95,        # LOWER → tighter ellipse (**tweak this first**)
      size = 0.7,
      linetype = "solid",
      color = "black",
      alpha = 0.7
    )
  
  
  
  # --- 8. Save PDF ---
  ggsave(
    filename = pdf_output_path,
    plot = p,
    device = cairo_pdf,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  message("✅ 4-quadrant metabolite plot PDF saved to: ", pdf_output_path)
}

```

)
